subject: Re: ClearMap POC kickoff — checking timeline and next steps
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Li <jordan@clearmap.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: ClearMap POC kickoff — recap & proposed next steps

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we’re aligned:

- Goal: validate ClearMap’s entity-extraction pipeline using Redwood’s inference runtime on a 2-week POC (focus on latency and cost delta vs current infra).
- Scope: 3 representative datasets (logs, customer emails, mapped geo-features).
- Success metrics: >=95% entity recall on the sample set + median latency < 150ms at 1 token/sec baseline.

Proposed kickoff: Wednesday 24 Mar — we’ll provision a sandbox model stack, hand you a concise checklist to complete the onboarding, and run a short integration smoke test.

I attached a one-page POC-setup checklist that walks through the small infra steps (API key, VPC peering options, sample dataset upload). If you prefer, Monica can run the initial provisioning for you.

Can you confirm: 1) the proposed kickoff date works for your infra team, and 2) whether you want Monica to handle provisioning?

If tomorrow works, I’ll lock it in and send a calendar invite with the onboarding agenda.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T +1 (415) 555-0191
https://redwood.ai

Attachment: POC-setup-checklist.pdf

From: Jordan Li <jordan@clearmap.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearMap POC kickoff — recap & proposed next steps

Hey Tessa —

Really appreciate the clear recap. Heads-up: our infra lead is out until next Tuesday and we’ve got a higher-priority migration this week, so could we push the kickoff to the week of Mar 29? I still want to do the POC — the timeline is just tighter on our side.

If Monica can provision anything in advance (keys, sandbox), that would help speed things up once our infra lead is back.

Thanks,
Jordan
Co-Founder & CTO | ClearMap AI
jordan@clearmap.ai

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Li <jordan@clearmap.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearMap POC kickoff — recap & proposed next steps

Thanks for the update, Jordan — understood.

We can absolutely be flexible. Short offer to keep momentum: Monica can provision the sandbox resources and send you a pre-configured API key + a tiny helper script that runs the smoke test — that way your infra lead only needs to approve the VPC peering when they’re back (minimal work).

If that sounds good, Monica — can you provision the sandbox for ClearMap (small GPU instance, sample model, API key) and share the checklist and script? I’ll plan to follow up with Jordan next Wednesday to confirm the on-site validation.

Marcus — FYI in case you want to be looped in on performance baselining.

—
Tessa

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Li <jordan@clearmap.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quick check — POC still a priority? Offer to unblock + small credit

Jordan —

Following up since I haven’t seen activity on the sandbox or the checklist we shared. I want to make sure this POC is still a priority for ClearMap and to offer a couple of options to reduce friction:

1) Concierge setup: Monica can run the initial provisioning and a guided 30-min walkthrough with your infra lead (we’ll handle the smoke test).
2) Calendar-free test: if you’d rather we run an onboarding-run on our side using a synthetic sample (no infra changes required) we can produce the baseline numbers and share the logs for your team to validate later.
3) Small kickoff credit: we’ll apply a $500 trial credit to the POC to cover compute while you sort the peering/approvals.

Attached is the checklist again and a draft SOW (light) showing the POC scope and timeline. If the project has lower priority now, no problem — just let me know and we can pause the work and reopen when it’s higher priority.

Next steps I suggest: pick one of the options above and reply with the preferred kickoff week (or "pause"). If I don’t hear back by Apr 8 I’ll assume you want to pause and we’ll archive the sandbox.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T +1 (415) 555-0191
https://redwood.ai

Attachments: POC-setup-checklist.pdf, SOW_Redwood-v1.docx
